title: Occluder bounds overlay and transform verification
purpose: Provide fast visual confirmation that occluders are where we expect relative to particles and light.

steps.detail: Compute AABB for icosphere and disc in object space; transform to world using the TLAS instance transforms to get world-space AABB.
Render simple wireframe boxes or lines for the world-space AABBs using a lightweight debug pipeline (solid color lines). Add a toggle key (B) to show/hide.
Print the instance 3x4 row-major matrices and the resulting AABB min/max once after build and whenever transforms change.

acceptance: Toggling the bounds overlay shows boxes tightly wrapping occluders
Printed transforms and AABBs match visual placement
notes: Overlay can be drawn in the same pass with a simple line list, or a tiny secondary pipeline. Aim for minimal interference with main render.
